_comment: Hand corrections for the few portraits the head finder gets wrong: a banner or raised weapon held above the head reads as the head, and a subject with no head at all -- a drone, a swarm -- gives it nothing to find. Each value is [centre-x, centre-y, side] as FRACTIONS of the source portrait (x and side of its width, y of its height), so a correction survives the portrait being re-installed at a different resolution. Re-run tools/make-tokens.py after editing.
